Under the approved Reading B, filtering out Zebra Finch sites that do NOT show >90% or <10% methylation removes 849 of the 1,140 sites (291 sites are kept).

Details:
- Site key = Pos (1:1 with Chromosome+StartPosition+EndPosition); 1,140 unique sites.
- A site is KEPT if at least one of its per-sample rows has MethylationPercentage > 90 or < 10.
- A site is REMOVED if all of its per-sample values fall within [10%, 90%] (inclusive boundaries).
- Result: kept = 291, removed = 849, total = 1,140 (291 + 849 = 1,140 ✓).

Verification: the minimum MethylationPercentage among removed-site rows is 10.0 and the maximum is 90.0; 100% of removed-site rows lie within [10, 90]. Numbers match the inspection (849 removed / 291 kept).
